newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's budget deficit 3.14 bln shekels in June.
newsitem.headline: Israel's budget deficit 3.14 bln shekels in June.

text.p: Israel posted a budget deficit of 3.136 billion shekels in June, preliminary figures released by the Treasury on Tuesday show.
Note: Figures are in millions of shekels. They do not include credit granted.

The government's deficit is usually high in June, boosted by interest payments on government loans and by a bonus paid to civil servants. Nevertheless, Treasury officials had been expecting a somewhat smaller deficit.
The domestic deficit was 2.937 billion shekels in June, compared with a May surplus of 413 million shekels, bringing the first-half deficit to 2.653 billion shekels.
The Treasury said it injected 841 million shekels of liquidity into the economy, reducing the cumulative first-half absorption to 4.815 billion shekels.
It said it raised the equivalent of 209 million shekels abroad, 1.297 billion shekels in the domestic market and 607 million shekels from privatisation.
